verdict.rationale: Jina Reader explicitly supports `x-instruction` (natural-language field extraction) and `x-json-schema` headers powered by ReaderLM-v2, letting the model decide what to extract without hand-written selectors, and the `research` preset targets AI agents needing structured, citable output. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the LLM-driven extraction reliably produces correct structured fields (only vendor docs describe this, no third-party test).
